pages.title: Dimensional Residue
pages.text: The leftovers of hyperdimensional work. It is a murky, shifting fluid that contains traces of everything that passed through four dimensions. It is warm and faintly luminous, and it separates into useful fractions if distilled.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Assembling tesseracts with dark matter lenses and exotic matter, I found a residue left behind that contained fragments of everything. Distilled in the Fractionation Spire, it yielded useful matter again.

Made in $(item)Tesseract Assembler$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Geometric Topology.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Chronon Gas, Dark Matter, Dimensional Singularity, Exotic Matter, Inflaton Field, Spacetime Slag.
